_comment: PRECRIME runtime/API config sample. Copy to precrime_config.json and fill in API keys locally. Product/sales truth (company, pitch, trade, buyers, geography) lives in DOCS/VALUE_PROP.md -- never here.
_databaseFile_note: The ONE place that selects PRECRIME's SQLite DB. Change this line + restart to switch databases. Accepts a path relative to the project root (e.g. data/myproject.sqlite) OR an absolute path (e.g. C:/Users/Scott/.../leedz.sqlite).
_chromeScrape_note: true = background fb/ig SCRAPE workers drive your logged-in Chrome via the mcp-chrome bridge (:12306), in EVERY mode. Requires mcp-chrome-bridge + the extension. The bridge is single-client and the pipeline owns it: the conductor serializes browser workers to one at a time. The orchestrator has no chrome tools.
_browsePacingMs_note: SPEED IS NOT THE GOAL -- staying invisible is. Minimum milliseconds between chrome-bridge fetches to the SAME domain (old.reddit.com and www.reddit.com count as one). Every browse caller (workers, orchestrator, signal drills) shares ONE paced queue, and +/-30% random jitter is applied so the rhythm never looks mechanical. If a fetched page looks like a bot-block wall, that domain is automatically frozen for 45 minutes. 30000 (30s) is deliberately conservative: raise only if scraping stalls, LOWER it never below 10000, and if a platform still blocks us the answer is a higher value, not retries.
_workers_note: No workers block on purpose: orchestrator is chosen by the LAUNCHER, not config. precrime.bat sets PRECRIME_WORKER_* (Claude); goose.bat sets none -> conductor uses its goose defaults (goose run --instructions <skill>). Hardcoding gooseBin here would force one orchestrator on both paths. Conductor defaults cover pollMs/maxWorkers/port/skillsRoot.

workers._maxWorkers_note: CONCURRENCY vs PROVIDER RPM: total simultaneous workers (goose spawns + background in-process jobs). Each worker makes ~8-12 LLM requests/min (one per tool turn) and ALL workers + the server's own judge/apply calls share ONE provider rate limit. On a 50 rpm budget (openrouter free tiers) 10 workers is ~2x over budget and guarantees rate-limit ORPHANs the moment the queue fills; 4 stays under it. Raise only on a paid tier with real rpm headroom. Focus > breadth: fewer workers also means the vertical (drill) work gets the rpm budget instead of the horizontal sweep.
